rationale: C02 is an exceptionally close drafting template: it uses the same Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen, the same Pennsylvania-specific interstate-commerce finding, the same sequence of recitals, the same thirty-day reporting requirement, and the same section 10 status-quo provision. The later order chiefly substitutes the Monongahela Connecting Railroad Company for the Aliquippa and Southern Railroad Company. C13 is nearly identical but earlier; C08 is also highly similar and more recent, but C02 most exactly matches the wording and machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a dispute exists between the Monongahela Connecting Railroad Company, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen, a labor organization
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a dispute exists between the Aliquippa and Southern Railroad Company, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen, a labor organization
shared_material.explanation: The same sentence frame and labor organization are retained, with only the railroad name changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce within the State of Pennsylvania to a degree such as to deprive that portion of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce within the State of Pennsylvania to a degree such as to deprive that portion of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.explanation: This Pennsylvania-specific factual recital is reproduced verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: The operative reporting requirement is identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Monongahela Connecting Railroad Company or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Aliquippa and Southern Railroad Company or this employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The same statutory status-quo machinery and wording are used, adapted only to the new railroad.
